title: ecs-service request
description: Inputs an app team supplies to deploy via modules/ecs-service. This mirrors that module's variables.tf and should be regenerated whenever the module's inputs change.

module.description: Must match the directory name under modules/ so CI knows which schema and which module source to use.

module_version.description: Exact git tag of the module to deploy, e.g. modules/ecs-service/v1.2.0. Floating refs (main, no tag) are rejected by CI.

name.description: Short, DNS-safe service name. Used to derive resource names.

team.description: Owning team slug, must match an entry in teams.yaml (checked separately in CI, not by this schema).

environment.description: Deploy target. Drives the networking module's VPC/subnet lookup.

tags.description: Free-form extra tags merged on top of the platform-standard ones (name/team/environment are added automatically, don't repeat them here).

image.description: Full image reference including tag or digest. 'latest' is rejected by CI.

env.description: Plain (non-secret) environment variables. Use secrets_arn for anything sensitive.

secrets_arn.description: ARNs of Secrets Manager secrets to inject as env vars. Never put secret values directly in the request.

iam_addons.description: Pre-approved permission add-ons to attach to the task role. Must come from the platform's published catalog (modules/_shared/iam-addons) — arbitrary policy JSON is not accepted here by design.

public.description: Whether the service gets an internet-facing ALB listener vs internal-only.
